title: Seeds in Two Pots
story: Aisha planted bean seeds in two pots for science club. She put both pots by the same window. She watered the first pot every day and left the second dry. After a week, green shoots appeared only in the wet pot. The dry seeds did not change. Aisha wrote that plants need water to grow. She showed the pots to the club and labelled them clearly.
